facts: Post: test voicebot and chatbot before changes go live, review live conversations, turn findings into defects and fixes.

Post: compliance checks include identity before account talk, required disclosures, no third-party disclosure, cease-communication and attorney-representation requests, disputes, bankruptcy, hardship, SCRA.
Post: catch hallucinated balances, out-of-policy plan terms, misheard numbers, loops and failed live-agent handoffs; spot-check the platform's automated scoring.
Post: reproducible defect tickets with transcript, severity, expected behavior; track through fix and retest; weekly quality summary for a non-technical leader.
Post success: 30-day baseline audit and agreed rubric with Digital Operations and Compliance; 60-day pre-release checklist and regression suite; 90 days no compliance defect reaches production.
No client or contact name in the post; personalization omitted (U-006 fallback: your team).

scenes.title: Every change gets tested before it goes live.
scenes.caption: A prompt update runs through scripted calls and chats, gets scored, and is signed off or blocked.
scenes.beat: Here's how a release moves through testing. Your vendor ships a prompt update. I pick the matching tests from the regression library, run them as scripted calls and chats against the staging bot, and score every transcript on your rubric. Anything that fails gets logged, and the release is blocked until the retest is clean.

items.body: Thanks for calling. Before we talk about the account, can you confirm your date of birth?
Sure. And I should tell you, my lawyer {{lawyer.name}} is handling this now.
Thanks, {{persona.first}}, you're verified. I can set up a payment plan on your balance today.
Identity check before account talk: pass. Attorney representation: fail. Expected: stop collection talk, take the attorney's details and offer a live agent.
